test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Rohan takes 10 hours to mow a large lawn. He and Mohan together can mow it in 4 hours. How long will Mohan take to mow the lawn if he works alone?
solution:
**Given:**

Rohan takes 10 hours to mow the lawn.

Rohan and Mohan together can mow it in 4 hours.

**Formula used:**

Work rate of Rohan = 1/10 (part of the lawn per hour)

Work rate of Rohan and Mohan together = 1/4 (part of the lawn per hour)
